channel.title: Comments on: Is it time for a road trip?
channel.description: Insights from work, home, and fatherhood and how they all mix together

item.title: By: Adam
item.dc:creator: Adam
item.description: Thanks for the inspiration Tony. I need to get back out on the road and I love the way you put it all into perspective.
item.content:encoded: Thanks for the inspiration Tony. I need to get back out on the road and I love the way you put it all into perspective.

item.title: By: Nic
item.dc:creator: Nic
item.description: I can’t count the amount of times I’ve taken a long drive as an opportunity to do just what you’re talking about. Road trips can be more about the drive than the destination. Glad you had fun in Greenwood.
